content: Props are how parent components communicate with their children. They are like little packages or letters that store information, or even little machines (functions), to be passed down to the child component.
Props can be any kind of JavaScript value, including arrays, objects, and functions.
Think of this cafe as your entire React app: the lobby is App.js (the parent), and each room is a child component.

The cafe has only one entrance: the front door (you entering through App.js). Each room can only be entered through the lobby, and there is no door between the two rooms (the same way two child components cannot communicate without going through their parent).
